explanation: Q1 selects drinkers who only frequent bars serving beers they like. Q2 adds an extra constraint that for each bar they frequent, no other beer exists in their likes besides those served at that bar. This makes Q2 more restrictive than Q1.
counterexample_dsp: A drinker (Alice) likes two beers (A and B) and frequents a bar (Bar1) that serves both. Q1 includes Alice since all beers at Bar1 are liked. Q2 excludes her because the bar serves multiple beers she likes, violating its second condition.
